explication: Abyss is a Jellyfin visual theme, installed manually or through platform-specific setup flows. The administrator’s main workflow applies the theme and Jellyfin settings, then uses the themed client; the optional Spotlight add-on presents Continue Watching content as a home banner. README documents the install outcomes and theme capabilities. Source excerpts show the Spotlight loader’s iframe, lifecycle and backdrop behavior, but do not expose installer internals or the Spotlight page implementation, so those connections are documented rather than inferred from unsampled code.
